open_items: Two rounds recorded, not three. Reflow ($15M+ seed, Feb 2026) lists BTV as an investor in search results but Axios returned 403 and Pulse.bot failed to load, so no fetched page supports it. Outpost Series A (Mar 2026) seen only in a CB Insights search snippet.
Layer: Seedtable-type database sources tag BTV as lead; the press release says Emergence Capital led. Kaaj: TechCrunch does not say who led; other outlets in search results say Kindred Ventures led.

Only latest fund (Fund III, $140M, 2025-10-01) recorded. Earlier funds seen: Fund I $75M (Sept 2020 per TechCrunch 2022, lead says 2020-08-12) and Fund II $150M plus $75M opportunity fund (Feb 2022, lead says 2022-02-16). Press describes the $225M as combined.
HQ San Francisco comes from the 2022 TechCrunch article only; the lead list says Bay Area / NYC. No pitch or contact link on btv.vc, so application_url and cold-inbound are left out.
